verdict: 2/9 signals fired — behavioral 2 fired, valuation 0 fired. Template window closed 2026-11-20 (7 days ago) with 0 valuation signals fired — the timing template missed; price is the referee now. Reclaim of the $73k STH cost-basis line favors 'bottom already in'; a close below realized price keeps the capitulation path live.

gates.name: Price proves the level
gates.detail: Need 3 consecutive — 3 more to go (2022's fakeout died at 2) — then a weekly close over the $84.5k supply shelf that holds. Shelf close: no; holding now: no. Weekly close < $72k kills it.

gates.name: Demand replaces the squeeze
gates.detail: Need 3 straight completed weeks >= $1,000M (now 0) AND 14d funding under 12% ann. — i.e. at/below the ~11% neutral baseline — while price holds (spot-led, not re-levered). CryptoQuant spot+futures demand staying positive through late Sep is the manual third check — no free feed. Funding spiking with price flat kills it.

gates.name: The events don't break it
gates.value: PCE print: BROKE $75k · FOMC decision: BROKE $70k
gates.detail: PCE then the Sep 16 FOMC, absorbed without losing the floor on a close — a hawkish print absorbed would be the strongest signal of all. Clarity Act vote is a bonus accelerant, not a requirement.

gates.name: Time runs out on the bears
gates.detail: The Q4-flush thesis is a WINDOW (early-mid Oct cluster), not just a target. A flush needs momentum to feed on; every week above the 50W EMA subtracts one from the bears. Above the line at the deadline = no mechanism left.
